subject: 赌场
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Generate exactly ONE isolated game building sprite for tianshu default, Ming dynasty northern Chinese prefectural city architectural kit, original anonymous composite, not a reconstruction of a named monument. Realistic ancient Chinese architecture, same natural material realism and detail density as the attached Song stable reference; reference is style ONLY, change architecture to northern Ming gray brick and gray clay tile, modest timber, restrained hard-gable yingshan roof with straight compact eaves. Orthographic 2:1 dimetric projection, yaw 45 degrees, pitch 30 degrees, NO perspective convergence. East ground axis projects down-right at slope +0.5; north ground axis up-right at slope -0.5; vertical posts stay vertical. Thin almost-flat footprint pad with clearly visible left, front, right corners, not a pedestal. Footprint proportions refer to ground axes, NOT canvas proportions. Main light from SCREEN UPPER LEFT; short soft contact shadow toward lower right. Entire object and base uncut, generous transparent margins. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA background, no opaque background or painted checkerboard. No people, animals, writing, pseudo-glyphs, signs, numbers, modern objects, palace ornament on common buildings, Qing imperial decoration, fantasy, neighboring buildings, sky, water, scenery, thick diorama plinth, broad shadows, tilt shift, toy plastic, cropping. Asset bld_kit_ming_north_casino. One modest 10 by 8 metre northern Ming gambling-house building, single storey broad hard-gable gray tile roof, gray brick walls and dark timber posts, three open front bays reveal TWO plain wooden gambling tables with small ivory counters and simple bowls but absolutely no people, written marks or modern playing cards. Plain square wooden lattice side windows and heavy unpainted double wood door at one end, no signboard, no lanterns. A thin flat gray brick ground footprint 10:8 axis ratio, clearly deeper than a shop strip; front faces screen lower-left. Avoid elaborate curling eaves or palace architecture. Ground edge slopes exactly +0.5 and -0.5.

references.role: 仅材质、细节密度和写实程度，屋顶年代与视角须服从本prompt
